reviewer.model_reasoning: Inherited session configuration; no override requested
reviewer.read_only: Product source was read only. One explicitly allowed JSON report and an isolated temporary HTTP/fake-provider fixture were used. OS sandbox enforcement was not independently audited.

verdict: No independently confirmed high or medium defect within the frozen, single-server activation and per-project budget boundary. This is a limited code/evidence review, not actual Claude, account identity, invoice, complete UI, or production-readiness acceptance.

sources: general_chat_config.py strict configuration and lazy credential factory
chat_general.py actual transport, manifest binding, submission, pricing and failure paths
app.py server and CLI configuration entrypoints
ledger.py attempt fencing and common budget exposure guard
method.applied: Before/current diff, configuration/browser/provider trust-boundary tracing, exact consent and attempt/reservation state transitions, CE Poisoning/Distraction/Confusion/Clash checks, and one independent synthetic HTTP failure probe.
method.limits: No source edits, full-suite duplication, browser, real provider, credentials, environment-variable access, user data, registry changes or deployment. Evidence supplied by other workers is identified separately from the independently executed probe.

unchanged_provider_contract_sources.basis: Compared with the earlier primary-source contract research receipt

observations.observation: No config or enabled=false produces no actual transport. The closed schema rejects extra/duplicate fields and inline credentials or endpoints; workspace UUID, connection identity/revision and model/price revision are pinned. Config loading and construction do not call the credential supplier. The CLI supplies the existing bounded adapter, rather than a permanently disabled placeholder.
observations.limit: The workspace identity check occurs after Store construction, before explicit recover/worker setup and before credential/network access; this review does not claim that a wrong workspace creates zero filesystem changes.

observations.observation: The actual path validates exact adapter and transport classes, fixed endpoints, absent custom opener, immutable configuration and pinned supplier/transport identities. Config digest participates in the existing transport/manifest binding. Fixture and loopback transport contracts remain separate.

One server cannot activate actual general chat together with legacy chat_configuration and its separate journal. The common SQL budget guard now also recognizes a reserved hold linked to an outcome_unknown general turn with update_failed journal state. Ordinary reserved work, other budgets and missing general-chat tables retain their prior behavior.
observations.limit: This is a per-server startup restriction and per-project SQL budget boundary. It does not prove a provider-account-wide ceiling or coordinate unrelated admin-launched processes.

observations.kind: code, supplied tests and independent probe
observations.observation: not_sent requires the exact actual LiveTransport/AnthropicChatAdapter and the closed pre-delegate credentials failure category. Ledger finalization requires the original owner, a transaction and sending state. Existing observed/unknown terminal attempts cannot be relabeled. Reservation release is a separate authorized runtime operation. Provider transport/HTTP errors continue to retain uncertainty; prior observed round usage is not erased.

Capability distinguishes configured actual execution mode from verified account/billing facts: account_verified=false and billing_verified=false. The 22 activation tests use a synthetic stdlib opener even when mode is anthropic-live. Neither those mode fields nor live_model_called in such a fixture prove a real provider invocation.

ce_assessment.Poisoning: Browser JSON has no activation route; it cannot inject a key, provider URL or server Configuration. A serialized provider response does not create a Python credentials exception. The new configuration does not turn supplied prose into execution approval. Live adversarial-model behavior was not tested.
ce_assessment.Distraction: The change reuses existing bounded adapters, manifests and ledger functions. No additional SDK, general orchestration framework, RAG system or media-generation scope was introduced.
ce_assessment.Confusion: Configured, count/message attempted, observed usage estimate, reconciled invoice and actual-model verification are kept distinct. Test sockets remain synthetic evidence; the existing stricter billing-dimension policy was not changed into missing-equals-zero.
ce_assessment.Clash: Default-off startup and existing fixture/loopback modes are retained. Actual general and separate legacy journals cannot be enabled together in one server. Current documentation still needs the driver's explicit new-stage update rather than interpreting the code change as overall production acceptance.

independently_executed.name: Remote HTTP401 remains unknown, not known-not-sent
independently_executed.method: Reused GeneralChatActivationHTTPTest helpers in one temporary platform HTTP server. The production bounded transport's stdlib opener was synthetic; it raised an HTTPError(401) at the message request after a successful synthetic count. No actual provider or environment key was used.
independently_executed.command_shape: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B, isolated inline probe importing tests.test_general_chat_activation
independently_executed.cleanup: Temporary HTTP server, thread, stdlib patch and TemporaryDirectory were cleaned through the existing test cleanup handlers. No live parent process handle was reused.

handoff_notes: Use the physical uppercase SOURCE-BEFORE.json filename in portable links; the macOS filesystem also accepts the lowercase spelling used in the task prompt.

The actual external account, authentication, response billing dimensions and request-level invoice reconciliation remain unverified. General-chat billing reconciliation is still a separate operational requirement, not something this code review declares complete.

The driver still owns independent whole-regression integration, actual browser workflow, final documentation and approval for any real paid call. This reviewer did not grant activation, registration, deployment or payment authority.
